# Canvio

> Canvio is an online whiteboard and visual knowledge workspace for learning, planning, research, concept mapping, connected notes, and collaborative work.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://canvio.space/): Start a blank board or open a demo workspace.
- [How Canvio works](https://canvio.space/how-it-works): Learn the Start, Build, Connect, and Deliver workflow.
- [Canvio updates](https://canvio.space/updates): Read product notes, design notes, guides, and releases.
- [Canvio support](https://canvio.space/support): Report problems, ask questions, and request improvements.

## Product capabilities

- Infinite online whiteboard for visual thinking
- Notes, shapes, frames, ink, highlighter, images, maps, and code
- Relations with labels and routed connections
- AI-assisted editable board creation
- Presentation, collaboration, export, and import workflows

## Privacy and indexing

Workspace URLs under `/w/` are private working spaces and should not be indexed as public documentation. Public product information is available through the pages above and the [sitemap](https://canvio.space/sitemap.xml).

## Contact

For product questions, bug reports, UX feedback, or feature requests, email [support@canvio.space](mailto:support@canvio.space).
